card.name: Start of confounded, confers, confirmed
card.fires_on: The word piece "conf" at the start of confounded, confers or confirmed in label text, mostly after "were", "dose" or "nitrite". It also fires weakly on a few similar word starts such as "Gr" in "Graded".

modes.label: confounded by
modes.description: "conf" starting "confounded" after "were" or "with", about other medications or factors.
modes.example: These events were<< conf>>ounded by concomitant medications and/or

modes.label: confers benefit
modes.description: "conf" starting "confers" after "this dose" in statements about no added benefit.
modes.example: there is no evidence that this dose<< conf>>ers additional significant benefit and this dose was

modes.label: Confirmed
modes.description: Capitalized "Conf" starting "Confirmed" at the start of a sentence.

card.writes: It pushes toward word starts like "Alter" and "alt" and away from "Tier" words, which gives no clear meaning.
card.plain: It fires on the start of the words confounded, confers and confirmed when they are split into pieces.
